# Riehl J, Rijal R, Nitz L, et al. 2021. Domain Organization of the UBX Domain Containing Protein 9 and Analysis of Its Interactions With the Homohexameric AAA + ATPase p97 (Valosin-Containing Protein). Front Cell Dev Biol 9:748860. https://doi.org/10.3389/fcell.2021.748860
